source='''def transform(grid):
    colors = sorted({value for row in grid for value in row if value != 0})
    pieces = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color]
        top = min(r for r, _ in cells)
        bottom = max(r for r, _ in cells)
        left = min(c for _, c in cells)
        right = max(c for _, c in cells)
        pieces.append([[grid[r][c] for c in range(left, right + 1)] for r in range(top, bottom + 1)])
    height = max(len(piece) for piece in pieces)
    out = [[0] * sum(len(piece[0]) for piece in pieces) for _ in range(height)]
    offset = 0
    for piece in pieces:
        for r, row in enumerate(piece):
            out[r][offset:offset + len(row)] = row
        offset += len(piece[0])
    return out
'''

source='''def transform(grid):
    colors = {value for row in grid for value in row if value != 0}
    pieces = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color]
        top = min(r for r, _ in cells)
        bottom = max(r for r, _ in cells)
        left = min(c for _, c in cells)
        right = max(c for _, c in cells)
        pieces.append((color, top, bottom, left, right))
    spread_x = max((p[3] + p[4]) / 2 for p in pieces) - min((p[3] + p[4]) / 2 for p in pieces)
    spread_y = max((p[1] + p[2]) / 2 for p in pieces) - min((p[1] + p[2]) / 2 for p in pieces)
    horizontal = spread_x >= spread_y
    pieces.sort(key=lambda p: ((p[3] + p[4]) / 2 if horizontal else (p[1] + p[2]) / 2))
    crops = [[[grid[r][c] for c in range(p[3], p[4] + 1)] for r in range(p[1], p[2] + 1)] for p in pieces]
    if horizontal:
        height = max(len(piece) for piece in crops)
        out = [[0] * sum(len(piece[0]) for piece in crops) for _ in range(height)]
        offset = 0
        for piece in crops:
            for r, row in enumerate(piece):
                out[r][offset:offset + len(row)] = row
            offset += len(piece[0])
        return out
    width = max(len(row) for piece in crops for row in piece)
    out = []
    for piece in crops:
        out.extend([row + [0] * (width - len(row)) for row in piece])
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'), globals())
